# Everything we build.
Four services, kept deliberately short so each one gets our full attention. Every project starts with a fixed quote. Start a project Estimate the cost
Services Starting prices

### Landing pages
Campaign, offer and event pages built from your design, with your tracking and form wired up, ready the day your ads go live.
From $249 Up to 8 sections

### Business websites
Multi-page marketing sites built from your designs: clean structure, fast pages and a handover your team can actually work with.
From $599 Up to 5 pages

### Redesigns
We move dated or slow sites onto modern code while keeping the content, the URLs and the search rankings your client has earned.
Quoted per site After a quick review

### Overflow support
When projects pile up, send the overflow to us. We work behind your brand, follow your process and hand back clean, documented code.
Quoted per project White-label by default

## What we don't do
Saying this up front saves everyone time.
- WordPress or Shopify builds
- Large e-commerce stores with complex inventory
- Brand identity and visual design from scratch
- Paid ads, SEO campaigns or social media management
Start here Fixed quote in one working day

Title: White-Label Landing Page Development | Lumvik Solutions

Lumvik / What we build / Landing pages

# Landing pages that load fast and convert.
Campaign, offer and event pages built from your design, with your tracking and form wired up, ready the day your ads go live. Get a fixed quote Estimate the cost From $249 Up to 8 sections You own all the code
The problem Sound familiar?

## What agencies tell us
- The campaign launches Monday and the page isn't built yet
- Pages built in a page builder load slowly on phones
- Forms that silently fail and lose leads

## Who it's for
- Agencies launching paid campaigns for clients
- Teams with a finished design and a hard launch date
- Clients whose current pages are slow on phones
Scope From $249, up to 8 sections

## What you get.

### Included
- Built pixel-close from your Figma, XD or PDF
- Responsive on phone, tablet and desktop
- Form connected to your email, CRM or webhook
- Space for your tracking tags (GA4, Meta, LinkedIn)
- Page title, description and social preview image
- Two review rounds

### Not included
- Writing the copy or designing from scratch
- Paid ad setup or management
- Ongoing changes after the 14-day fix period
Typical timeline Confirmed in your quote

## How it runs, step by step.
- Day 0

### Brief and quote
You send the design and copy; we reply with a fixed quote and date.
- Day 1 to 2

### First build
Layout, content and responsive behaviour built and shared on a preview link.
- Day 3

### Forms and tracking
Form wired to your inbox or CRM, tracking tags added, everything tested.
- Day 3 to 5

### Review and launch
Two rounds of changes, then we deploy or hand over the code.
Quality In every build

## What every build includes.

### Responsive
Layouts checked at phone, tablet and desktop widths, with no sideways scrolling and tap targets sized for thumbs.

### Fast
Compressed images, minimal scripts and no heavy page builders. We check page speed before you see the first preview.

### Accessible
Semantic markup, visible keyboard focus, readable contrast and form errors that screen readers announce.

### Search-ready
Unique page titles and descriptions, a sitemap, robots.txt, social preview images and redirects for any changed URLs.

### Forms that work
Every form is submitted and checked end to end, so enquiries reach the right inbox or CRM from launch day.

### Clean handover
Readable code in your repository, deployed to your hosting, with a short note on how to make common edits.
Working together Communication

## How we work with your team.

### How we stay in touch
- Email or Slack, whichever your team already uses
- A written update at the end of every working day
- Replies to messages within one working day, usually much faster
- A private preview link that always shows the latest build

### What we need from you
- The design file or a reference, and the final copy
- Brand assets: logo, fonts, photos and icons
- Where the site should live and who owns the domain
- One person on your side who can approve changes
Questions All answers

## Before you ask.
How fast can a landing page be ready?
Most single pages are ready for review within a few working days of an agreed brief. We confirm the exact date in the quote.
Can you add A/B test variants?
Yes. Each extra variant of an existing page is quoted at a reduced rate because the structure already exists.
Where will it be hosted?
On your hosting, your client's, or a free Vercel project we set up and transfer to you.
Can you build several pages for one campaign?
Yes. Each extra page that reuses the same design system is quoted at a reduced rate.
Do you write the copy?
No. We build from your copy. If a section is missing text, we'll flag it in the quote rather than guess.
Will it work with our ad platforms?
Yes. We add your Google, Meta or LinkedIn tags and check they fire before launch.
Other services What else we build

### Business websites
Multi-page marketing sites built from your designs: clean structure, fast pages and a handover your team can actually work with. Learn more

### Redesigns
We move dated or slow sites onto modern code while keeping the content, the URLs and the search rankings your client has earned. Learn more

### Overflow support
When projects pile up, send the overflow to us. Learn more
Start here Fixed quote in one working day

## Tell us what you're building.
Send a brief or a design file. You'll get one fixed price and a delivery date, usually within one working day. Send a brief Estimate the cost Or email lumvik.solutions@gmail.com

Lumvik / What we build / Business websites

# Business websites your clients can be proud of.
Multi-page marketing sites built from your designs: clean structure, fast pages and a handover your team can actually work with. Get a fixed quote Estimate the cost From $599 Up to 5 pages You own all the code
The problem Sound familiar?

## What agencies tell us
- A great design stuck in the queue because your developer is booked
- Sites that look right on desktop and fall apart on phones
- Handovers with no notes, so every small change needs a developer

## Who it's for
- Agencies with more website projects than developer hours
- Clients replacing an outdated site with a new design
- Teams that want a clean handover they can maintain
Scope From $599, up to 5 pages

## What you get.

### Included
- Up to 5 pages with shared navigation and footer
- Responsive layouts tested at phone and desktop widths
- Contact form connected to email or CRM
- Page titles, descriptions, sitemap and robots.txt
- Basic speed and accessibility checks
- Two review rounds and 14 days of fixes
- A short handover note on how to edit content

### Not included
- Brand or visual design from scratch
- Copywriting
- E-commerce with complex inventory
- Hosting and domain fees
Typical timeline Confirmed in your quote

## How it runs, step by step.
- Week 1, day 1

### Brief and quote
Design files, copy and hosting details in; fixed quote and date out.
- Week 1

### Templates and homepage
Shared navigation, footer and the homepage built first, so you can review the system early.
- Week 1 to 2

### Inner pages
Remaining pages built from the agreed templates, with forms and SEO basics.
- Week 2

### Review, test and launch
Two review rounds, a full launch checklist, then deployment and handover.
Quality In every build

## What every build includes.

### Responsive
Layouts checked at phone, tablet and desktop widths, with no sideways scrolling and tap targets sized for thumbs.

### Fast
Compressed images, minimal scripts and no heavy page builders. We check page speed before you see the first preview.

### Accessible
Semantic markup, visible keyboard focus, readable contrast and form errors that screen readers announce.

### Search-ready
Unique page titles and descriptions, a sitemap, robots.txt, social preview images and redirects for any changed URLs.

### Forms that work
Every form is submitted and checked end to end, so enquiries reach the right inbox or CRM from launch day.

### Clean handover
Readable code in your repository, deployed to your hosting, with a short note on how to make common edits.
Working together Communication

## How we work with your team.

### How we stay in touch
- Email or Slack, whichever your team already uses
- A written update at the end of every working day
- Replies to messages within one working day, usually much faster
- A private preview link that always shows the latest build

### What we need from you
- The design file or a reference, and the final copy
- Brand assets: logo, fonts, photos and icons
- Where the site should live and who owns the domain
- One person on your side who can approve changes
Questions All answers

## Before you ask.
Can our team edit the content after launch?
Yes. We can add a simple editable content area or blog, priced in the estimator, or hand over clean code your developers can edit.
Do you build on WordPress?
Not currently. We build in Next.js or clean HTML. If your client must stay on WordPress, we're not the right fit for that project.
What do you need to start?
The design files, final copy, brand assets, and where the site should live.
How many pages can you build?
The starting price covers up to 5 pages. Larger sites are quoted from the brief, with extra template-based pages from $90 each.
Can you match our client's brand exactly?
Yes, from the design file. We use the exact fonts, colours and spacing in the design, provided the font licences allow web use.
Do you handle hosting?
We deploy to your hosting or your client's. If there isn't any, we can set up a free Vercel project and transfer it to you.

Title: Website Redesign Development for Agencies | Lumvik

Lumvik / What we build / Redesigns

# Rebuild a slow site without losing what works.
We move dated or slow sites onto modern code while keeping the content, the URLs and the search rankings your client has earned. Get a fixed quote Estimate the cost Quoted per site After a quick review You own all the code
The problem Sound familiar?

## What agencies tell us
- A site that takes seconds to load on a phone
- A theme nobody dares to update
- Fear of losing Google rankings during a rebuild

## Who it's for
- Clients whose site is slow, dated or hard to update
- Agencies taking over a site built by someone else
- Brands refreshing their look without losing search traffic
Scope Quoted per site, after a quick review

## What you get.

### Included
- Review of the current site and a page-by-page plan
- Rebuild from your new design or a cleaned-up version of the current one
- Same URLs, or redirects mapped for any that change
- Page titles and descriptions carried over
- Before-and-after check on phones and desktops

### Not included
- Content rewriting
- SEO campaigns or link building
- Migrating large online stores
Typical timeline Confirmed in your quote

## How it runs, step by step.
- Days 1 to 2

### Review and plan
We audit the current site, list every page and URL, and send a fixed quote.
- Week 1

### Rebuild
New templates built from your design, with existing content moved across.
- Week 2

### Redirects and checks
URLs matched or redirected, titles and descriptions carried over, speed checked.
- Launch

### Switch over
We go live at a quiet time and watch for broken links in the first days.
Quality In every build

## What every build includes.

### Responsive
Layouts checked at phone, tablet and desktop widths, with no sideways scrolling and tap targets sized for thumbs.

### Fast
Compressed images, minimal scripts and no heavy page builders. We check page speed before you see the first preview.

### Accessible
Semantic markup, visible keyboard focus, readable contrast and form errors that screen readers announce.

### Search-ready
Unique page titles and descriptions, a sitemap, robots.txt, social preview images and redirects for any changed URLs.

### Forms that work
Every form is submitted and checked end to end, so enquiries reach the right inbox or CRM from launch day.

### Clean handover
Readable code in your repository, deployed to your hosting, with a short note on how to make common edits.
Working together Communication

## How we work with your team.

### How we stay in touch
- Email or Slack, whichever your team already uses
- A written update at the end of every working day
- Replies to messages within one working day, usually much faster
- A private preview link that always shows the latest build

### What we need from you
- The design file or a reference, and the final copy
- Brand assets: logo, fonts, photos and icons
- Where the site should live and who owns the domain
- One person on your side who can approve changes
Questions All answers

## Before you ask.
Will the client lose their rankings?
We keep URLs the same where possible and set up redirects where they change, which is what protects rankings in a rebuild. We can't promise rankings, as Google decides those.
Can you work from the existing site with no new design?
Yes. We can rebuild the current look on faster code, with small improvements we agree up front.
Can you keep our client's existing content?
Yes. We move the existing text and images across and tidy formatting as we go.
What happens to old URLs?
We keep them where possible and set up permanent redirects where they change, so links and search rankings carry over.

## Before you ask.
How does a monthly arrangement work?
We agree a set number of days or projects per month at a fixed rate, so you can plan capacity. Start with one project first if you prefer.
Can you work in our GitHub and Slack?
Yes. We'll work wherever your team already works.
Do you follow our coding standards?
Yes. Send your conventions, linting rules or an example repo and we'll match them.
What if we need to pause?
Monthly arrangements can be paused or ended with notice, with no penalties.

Title: Outsourced Web Development for Agencies | Lumvik Solutions

Lumvik / For agencies

# Your brand on the front. Our code behind it.
You keep the client, the relationship and the margin. We handle the build quietly, on scope and on the date we agree. Send a brief See pricing
The arrangement White-label

## What you can count on.

### Confidentiality
- We never contact your client unless you ask us to
- No Lumvik credits in the site, code or files
- We'll sign your NDA, or use ours

### Ownership
- All code and assets are yours once paid
- Delivered to your GitHub, your hosting or as a zip
- No lock-in and no ongoing license fees

### Communication
- One named lead from brief to handover, never an account manager
- A written update at the end of every working day
- Email or Slack, whichever your team uses

### Quality checks
- Tested at phone and desktop widths before you see it
- Accessible markup, keyboard support and readable contrast
- Page titles, descriptions and basic SEO in place
Why agencies choose us Six reasons

## Why agencies work with us.

### Fixed price, before we start
You get one written quote with the scope, price and delivery date. It doesn't change unless you change the scope, so you can quote your client with confidence.

### Invisible to your client
No Lumvik name in the code, footer or files, and we never contact your client. Your agency stays the face of the project from start to finish.

### Work that moves overnight
Our India team works through the US night. Send feedback at the end of your day and find progress waiting in the morning, instead of losing a day per round.

### A named lead, not a ticket queue
One person owns your project from brief to handover and sends a written update every working day. You always know what's done and what's next.

### Code you own outright
Clean, readable code in your own repository or hosting once the invoice is paid. No lock-in, no licence fees, no developer you depend on forever.

### Small first project, low risk
Start with one landing page. If the quality or communication isn't right, you've lost very little, and you've learned it in a week.
Process Brief to handover

## The same five steps, every project.
-

### Brief
Send the design file, copy and any must-haves. Figma, a PDF or a rough sketch all work.
-

### Quote
Scope, price and a delivery date agreed in writing before any work starts.
-

### Build
Built in Next.js or clean HTML, with progress on a private preview link.
-

### Review
You check it on desktop and phone. Two rounds of changes are included.
-

### Handover
Deployed to your hosting or handed over as code. Yours, unbranded.

Compared Your options

## Lumvik, a freelancer or a new hire?
| | Lumvik | Freelance marketplace | Hiring in-house
| Price | Fixed quote per project | Varies widely; hourly is common | Full salary, benefits and tools
| Time to start | Quote within one working day | Days of interviews and trials | Weeks to months to hire
| White-label | By default, NDA on request | Depends on the person | Yes
| Cover when someone is away | A small team behind every project | Usually one person | Depends on team size
| Updates | Written, every working day | Depends on the person | Daily, in person
| Cost when there's no work | Nothing | Nothing | Full salary
Fit Honest about it

## Who we're right for.

### We're a good fit for
- Agencies with more design work than development hours
- Landing pages and marketing sites from a finished design
- Teams that want to try a partner with one small project first

### We're not the right fit for
- Large e-commerce builds with complex inventory
- Enterprise systems with strict compliance needs
- Projects that need someone on-site
Questions Partnership

## Partnership questions.
Can we start with a small test project?
Yes, and we recommend it. Send one landing page; if the quality and communication work for you, we take it from there.
What do you need from us to start?
A design file or reference, the copy, any brand assets, and where the site should live. If something's missing, we'll say what in the quote.
Which tools and platforms do you build with?
Mostly Next.js, React and Tailwind, deployed on Vercel. We can also deliver clean static HTML. We don't currently build on WordPress or Shopify.
How are changes handled?
Two review rounds are included in every quote. New features beyond the agreed scope are quoted separately before we start them.
How do we pay?
By international bank transfer or PayPal, invoiced in US dollars. 50% upfront and 50% on handover.

Payment How it works

## Simple, predictable payment.

### How you pay
- Invoiced in US dollars
- 50% to start, 50% on handover
- Larger projects split into milestones
- International bank transfer or PayPal

### If the scope changes
- We tell you before doing anything outside the quote
- New work is priced in writing first
- You decide whether to add it now or later
- No surprise invoices, ever
The small print Plain English

## What's in, what's out.

### Every quote includes
- Written scope and delivery date
- Private preview link during the build
- Full code handover once paid
- 14 days of fixes after launch

### Not included unless agreed
- Domain names and hosting fees
- Paid plugins, fonts or third-party services
- Copywriting and new design work
- Ongoing maintenance after the 14 days
Timelines are typical and confirmed in each quote.
Questions Pricing

## Pricing questions.
Why do you publish prices?
So you can tell quickly whether we fit your budget, and quote your own client with confidence before even talking to us.
Are these prices final?
They're starting points. After reading your brief we send one fixed price, which only changes if the scope changes.
Do you offer agency rates for regular work?
Yes. Agencies sending regular projects can agree a monthly arrangement with a lower per-project rate.
What if we're not happy with the work?
Two review rounds are included, and we fix anything that doesn't match the agreed scope for 14 days after launch. Starting with a small project keeps your risk low.

Title: White-Label Web Development FAQ | Lumvik Solutions

Lumvik / Answers

# Straight answers.
Straight answers to what agencies ask before working with us. Can't find yours? Email us .

## Working together
Who does the work?
A small team: Jay, our founder, leads every project, working with engineers from NIT Rourkela and IIT Goa and developers in the US. Your project has one named lead from brief to handover. We use modern tools, including AI-assisted coding, to move faster, and every change is written or reviewed by an engineer before you see it.
Will my client know you built it?
No. We never contact your client, never add our name to the site or code, and are happy to sign your NDA.
Can we start with a small test project?
Yes, and we recommend it. Send one landing page and judge the quality and communication yourself.
How do we communicate?
By email or Slack, whichever your team uses. You get a written update at the end of every working day.
What hours do you work?
Indian working hours, which run through the US evening and night. Send feedback at the end of your day and progress is usually waiting in the morning.

## Pricing and payment
How is a project priced?
From the brief. We send a fixed quote with a delivery date, and that number doesn't change unless the scope does. Use the cost estimator for a quick range.
How do we pay?
Invoiced in US dollars, by international bank transfer or PayPal. 50% to start and 50% on handover.
What isn't included?
Domains, hosting fees, paid plugins or fonts, copywriting, new design work, and maintenance after the 14-day fix period, unless agreed in the quote.

## Code and quality
Who owns the code?
You do, in full, once the final invoice is paid. We hand over the repository or deploy to your hosting.
What do you build with?
Mostly Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel, or clean static HTML. We don't currently build on WordPress or Shopify.
How do you check quality?
Every build is tested at phone and desktop widths, checked for keyboard access and readable contrast, and run through our launch checklist before you see it.
What if something breaks after launch?
Every build includes 14 days of free fixes for anything that doesn't match the agreed scope.

# Slidezza. A deck from a sentence.
Making a presentation takes hours, and most AI deck tools invent numbers. We built Slidezza to plan a deck you can edit before anything is written, then write and design it card by card. Visit Slidezza See a real deck it made
7
Card layouts
Title, section, bullets, columns, big numbers, quote and timeline, picked per card.
3
Cards at a time
Cards are written in parallel and appear one by one. A failed card never sinks the deck.
$12
Pro plan, monthly
Free and Pro plans with monthly credits, billed through Stripe subscriptions.
1
Click to change theme
Every card in the deck updates at once.
- Client | Our own product
- Sector | AI · Productivity
- Type | SaaS web app
- Status | Live
(01) The problem

## Hours of formatting, and numbers nobody checked.
People spend more time arranging slides than thinking about what to say. AI tools speed that up but tend to write a whole deck in one go, so a bad structure gets baked in, and figures appear with no source.
(02) What we built

## Outline first, then the deck, card by card.
- Prompt to outline: users rename, reorder, add or cut cards before anything is written
- Cards generate three at a time and appear live; reloading resumes unfinished cards
- Seven layouts chosen per card, with switchable themes and full-screen present mode
- Edit any card, or regenerate it with instructions
- View-only share links and PDF export, one 16:9 card per page
- Accounts, monthly credits, quality modes, and Stripe Checkout, portal and webhooks
(03) The stack

## Small, typed and tested.
Next.js and TypeScript on the front and back end, Prisma for data, Zod for validated AI output, the Claude API for writing, Stripe for billing and Vitest for tests. Credit charges are atomic, so parallel requests can't overspend.

Title: How to Brief a White-Label Web Developer | Lumvik

Lumvik / Guides / How to brief a white-label developer

# How to brief a white-label developer
What to send so the quote is accurate and the build matches the design the first time.
By Jay, founder of Lumvik Solutions · November 2026
Most delays in outsourced web projects come from the brief, not the build. A developer working from a vague brief has to guess, and every guess becomes a revision round. Here is what to include so the quote is accurate and the first version is close to final.

## 1. The design, at every width you care about
Send the design file itself (Figma, Adobe XD or a PDF), not screenshots. If you only have a desktop design, say how you expect the mobile layout to behave, or agree that the developer will adapt it sensibly and show you before going further.

## 2. Final copy and assets
Placeholder text hides layout problems: a real headline may wrap onto three lines where the dummy one fit on one. Send final copy where you can, plus logos, photos and icons in their original formats.

## 3. What every form and button should do
- Where form submissions go: an email address, a CRM, a webhook
- Which buttons link where, including external booking or payment tools
- Any tracking tags that must be on the page from launch

## 4. Where the site will live
Name the hosting, who owns the domain, and whether the developer should deploy or just hand over the code. This avoids last-day surprises with access and DNS.

## 5. The deadline, and whether it's real
Say whether the date is fixed (a campaign launch) or flexible. A good partner will tell you straight away if it's achievable. Short on time? Send the design file, the copy and the deadline. Those three answer most questions. Our brief form covers the rest.

Title: Website Launch Checklist for Agencies | Lumvik

Lumvik / Guides / Website launch checklist for agencies

# Website launch checklist for agencies
The checks to run before a client site goes live, so launch day is quiet.
By Jay, founder of Lumvik Solutions · November 2026
Launch problems are almost always small things nobody checked: a form going to an old inbox, a missing redirect, a page title still saying "Home". Run through this list before every client launch.

## Content and links
- No placeholder text or images left anywhere
- Every internal link and button goes where it should
- Phone numbers and emails are correct and clickable
- Legal pages (privacy, terms, cookies) exist where required

## Forms
- Submit every form once and confirm the message actually arrives
- Errors are clear when a field is missing or wrong
- Thank-you message or page appears only after a successful send

## Phones and browsers
- Check on a real phone, not only a resized desktop window
- No sideways scrolling on any page
- Buttons are big enough to tap comfortably
- Test in Chrome and Safari at a minimum

## Search and sharing
- Every page has its own title and description
- A sitemap and robots.txt exist and allow indexing
- Redirects are in place for any old URLs that changed
- Sharing a link shows the right title and preview image

## Handover
- The client or agency owns the domain and hosting accounts
- Code is in a repository the agency controls
- A short note explains how to make common edits Every Lumvik build goes through this list before you see it. See how we work with agencies .

Lumvik / Guides / Working with an offshore developer: what to agree up front

# Working with an offshore developer: what to agree up front
How agencies can get the cost and time-zone benefits of an offshore partner without the usual problems.
By Jay, founder of Lumvik Solutions · November 2026
Offshore development has a mixed reputation, and much of it is earned: missed deadlines, silence for days, work that doesn't match the design. Almost all of it comes from things that weren't agreed at the start. Agree these five and most of the risk disappears.

## 1. A fixed scope and price, in writing
Before any work starts, get the pages, features, number of review rounds and the price written down. Anything new after that is quoted separately before it's built.

## 2. How and when you'll hear from them
Agree an update rhythm: for example, a short written update at the end of each working day. Silence is the earliest warning sign, and a clear rhythm removes it.

## 3. Use the time difference on purpose
From India, the working day overlaps with a US night. Used well, that means you send feedback in your evening and find progress in your morning. Used badly, it means waiting a full day for every question. Batch your feedback and make it specific.

## 4. Who owns the code, and when
The code should become yours, in full, once the final invoice is paid, delivered to your own repository or hosting. Avoid arrangements where only the developer can deploy or edit.

## 5. Start small
Run a single landing page as a paid test before handing over a full client site. You'll learn more about quality and communication in one week than from any portfolio. This is exactly how Lumvik works: fixed quotes, daily updates and full code ownership. Start with a small project .
Start here Fixed quote in one working day

# Privacy
Last updated November 2026
This site doesn't use analytics, advertising trackers or cookies of its own. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address to deliver them.

## What we collect
Only what you send us by email, including through the brief form, which opens your own email app. That's usually your name, work email, company and project details.

## How we use it
To reply to you, prepare quotes and deliver projects. We don't sell or share it, and we don't add you to mailing lists.

## How long we keep it
As long as needed for the project and our accounting records, then we delete it. Ask any time and we'll delete or export what we hold about you.

## Contact
Email lumvik.solutions@gmail.com .

# Terms
Last updated November 2026
These are the standard terms behind every Lumvik quote. Anything agreed differently in a written quote takes priority.

## Quotes and scope
Each project has a written quote listing the scope, price, review rounds and delivery date. Work outside that scope is quoted separately before it starts.

## Payment
Invoiced in US dollars. 50% is due before work starts and 50% on handover, unless the quote sets other milestones.

## Ownership
Once the final invoice is paid, all code and project files we create for you are yours. We may keep a private copy for support during the fix period. We only show your project publicly with your written permission.

## Confidentiality
We keep your project, your clients and your materials confidential, and will sign your NDA on request.

## Fixes and support
Each build includes 14 days of free fixes for anything that doesn't match the agreed scope. Support after that is available at an agreed rate.

## Contact
Questions about these terms: lumvik.solutions@gmail.com .
